items.issue: The central label is inconsistently recognized as '帅' or replaced with 'XX'; title metadata suggests '散帅'.
items.disposition: Confirm the exact term from original audio and dense on-screen frames before quoting or indexing it.

items.issue: The claimed July 9 search disappearance, cross-platform limitation, removals and sub-week chronology are time-sensitive external facts.
items.disposition: Verify with dated platform captures, notices or independent reporting; edited screenshots alone are insufficient.

items.issue: Comparative moderation claims lack a defined sample, matched content, observation period and policy basis.
items.disposition: Keep on hold; do not state discriminatory enforcement as established fact.

items.issue: The video infers platform and beneficiary motives from differential availability and removal speed.
items.disposition: Attribute as Mikey's structural interpretation; do not claim knowledge of platform intent.

items.issue: Sparse montage frames include third-party posts, chats and faces with unclear public/private status and incomplete context.
items.disposition: Densify 0-75 and 360-480 seconds if needed, preserve privacy, and do not reconstruct cropped text or identities.

items.issue: The argument uses derogatory labels and broad claims about women, men and social-media behavior.
items.disposition: Do not adopt labels as factual categories or generalize selected posts to populations.

items.issue: ASR corruption affects the central term, platform names, idioms and some examples.
items.disposition: Use semantic paraphrase only until original-audio/on-screen verification is completed.
